- Native package-manager consistency checks timed out both before and after execution, so package-database health could not be independently compared (global:before_prepare:node1:package-health; global:after_executor:node1:package-health).
- The timed-out `yum repolist` process may have refreshed transient repository metadata, but the trace cannot establish whether it changed durable state; the remaining process was stopped (cmd-55274ab0b4bc4c91; cmd-2ef7168c30e141e3).
- Verifier confidence was 0.980; this is evidence confidence for this trial, not a repeatability estimate.
